about_the_game:
Enhance your experience with exclusive digital content for supporters of The Darkest Files!

This special pack includes:

  • 2 Premium Wallpapers for both mobile and desktop (Esther at Night and Day)

  • 14 Exclusive Emotes ready to use on Twitch and other platforms

  • 1 Printable Poster featuring "Esther at Night" (Cover)

  • 1 OST Teaser Track featuring "Five O'Clock Filing" - the atmospheric tune playing on the office radio

  • In-Depth Character Sheets revealing (almost) everything about your fellow prosecutors

  • 1 Digital Sticker Sheet containing 4 stickers to show your support

Perfect for people who missed our Kickstarter or backers looking for additional exclusive content. Thank you for supporting our vision of bringing this important historical story to life through immersive gameplay.

To access this content please proceed as follows:

Right-click on the product in your Steam Library and select "Properties".

Under the "Local Files" tab, select "Browse...".

Within the product's local files, locate a folder that has a similar name to the content you are searching for.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. Some scenes feature disturbing content in the form of narrative text or imagery and a sensitive general theme.
